item.title: Bristol's Kurdish community rallies for Rojava
item.description: Kurdish Bristolians Tara and Tanya speak to the Cable about betrayal, resistance and why the women-led revolution must be defended

item.title: 'Find your people': Lawi Anywar on Bristol's art scene
item.description: The Bristol-based multi-instrumentalist discusses mental health, masculinity and the challenges of thriving in a precarious creative sector

item.description: Neil chats with Joe Joyce on his controversial signing for Gloucester, the class system in rugby and facing the end of a sporting career.

item.title: We need to oppose Bristol Patriots' fake 'unity march'

item.description: Have you or someone you know experienced a health issue after consuming energy drinks? We want to hear from you

item.description: After last week’s demo exposed them, with out-and-out Nazis and a child sex offender showing up, is this the end of Bristol Patriots?
